task.title: Add structured, checkable blockers and a generic blocked-task reconciliation pass

owned: optional machine-checkable blocker fields in the governed status command
periodic, bounded reconciliation for explicitly structured blockers
fail-closed GitHub required-context and canonical dependency checks
the existing reopen-equivalent transition, including blocker and handoff resolution
not_changing: legacy prose-only blockers or any auto-clear heuristic for them
live feature enablement, deployment, broker, or capital behavior
composes_with: Antigravity's exact-head independent review and canonical review gate

github_pr_ci.resolved_when: the PR's configured required contexts are all represented as SUCCESS in statusCheckRollup

task_dependency.resolved_when: the referenced canonical task status equals required_status

opt_in_contract.legacy: An omitted check_kind remains a human-judgment blocker and is never auto-touched.

safety.cadence: The reconciler has its own configured interval (default 300 seconds, clamped to at least 60) and runs before runtime admission, outside the normal locked dispatch tick.
safety.github_failure_posture: Missing gh, timeout, failed command, malformed response, unknown branch protection, missing required context, and non-success all fail closed.
safety.transition: Only a fully resolved opt-in blocker set calls the existing persist_task_reassignment path with expected_status=blocked, resolving open blockers/handoffs and resetting failure_streak; shadow_only records the observation without mutation.

structured_blocker_command.evidence: command_blocker accepts github_pr_ci <pr-number> and task_dependency <task-id> [required-status] while preserving the legacy three-argument form.

github_ci_reconciliation.evidence: Focused test proves the task remains blocked until CI is green, then invokes the guarded reopen-equivalent transition.

dependency_reconciliation.evidence: Focused test proves a task_dependency blocker resolves only at its configured canonical status.

legacy_blocker_preservation.evidence: Supervisor and status-command tests prove a blocker without check_kind is not probed or reopened.

hot_tick_isolation.evidence: Focused test proves the interval prevents external probing at the normal dispatch cadence.

shadow_cutover.evidence: Focused test proves shadow_only reports a resolved blocker without reopening; configuration remains disabled and shadow-only by default.

excluded_dispatch_paths.evidence: The task diff does not modify poll_workers, process_queue, or reconcile_queue_records.

verification.command: "$PANTHEON_PY" -m py_compile .orchestrator/supervisor.py scripts/ai_status.py && jq empty .orchestrator/config.json && git diff --check origin/pr-4582..HEAD

verification.result: max_parallel, account_limit, failure_pause, dispatch_reason, and flag-off outbox shadow comparisons reported zero mismatches
passed before this evidence-only commit; the evidence commit is separately subject to the same PR CI gate
